dashboard.name: NutsNews Backend - Edge - Caddy Request Traffic
dashboard.description: 24 hour dashboard for Caddy request volume, status mix, redirects, errors, latency, safe paths, and bounded user-agent facets. Managed from ramideltoro/nutsnews-backend.

pages.name: Caddy traffic
pages.description: Request traffic and forwarding health from parsed Caddy logs.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND unit = 'caddy' FACET http.statusCode TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND unit = 'caddy' AND http.statusCode >= 300 AND http.statusCode < 400 FACET http.statusCode TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND unit = 'caddy' AND http.statusCode >= 400 FACET http.statusCode TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(request.durationMs), percentile(request.durationMs, 95) FROM Log WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND unit = 'caddy' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*), average(request.durationMs) FROM Log WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND unit = 'caddy' FACET request.path LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND unit = 'caddy' FACET userAgent.name LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago

SELECT count(*), latest(http.statusCode), latest(request.method) FROM Log WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND unit = 'caddy' AND http.statusCode >= 500 FACET request.path LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago

rawConfiguration.text: Use status trends first, then check redirects, upstream failures, and bounded parsed path facets. Avoid raw query-string analysis.
